quote_zh: 1、2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯的合成 ... 将26.43g  2-氯-3-甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.7％、0.1mol)，200ml氯仿，1.66g偶氮二异丁腈(99％、0.01mol)，33.75g氢溴酸(48％、0.2mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在60～65℃滴加22.7g双氧水(30％、0.2mol)，滴加完毕后继续反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后分层，有机层水洗、浓缩，乙醇进行重结晶、过滤、烘干得30.66g白色粉末，纯度98.8％，收率88.7％。
arithmetic_check: Charges, each checked with the printed percentage applied. Substrate methyl 2-chloro-3-methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate C10H11ClO4S, MW 262.71: 26.43 g x 99.7％ = 26.351 g / 0.1 mol implies 263.5, high by 0.3％, correct. Azobisisobutyronitrile C8H12N4, MW 164.21: 1.66 g x 99％ = 1.643 g / 0.01 mol implies 164.3, correct. Hydrobromic acid HBr, MW 80.91: 33.75 g x 48％ = 16.20 g gives 0.2002 mol against the printed 0.2 mol, correct, and this closure is what proves the 48％ is a solution strength rather than a solid assay. Hydrogen peroxide H2O2, MW 34.01: 22.7 g x 30％ = 6.81 g gives 0.2002 mol against the printed 0.2 mol, correct, same proof. No molar_mass_inconsistent is raised. Product closure: limiting input 0.100 mol; product methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate C10H10BrClO4S as named and drawn, MW 341.60; theoretical 0.100 x 341.60 = 34.16 g; printed mass 30.66 g at the printed purity 98.8％ is 30.292 g of pure product, which is 88.68％ of theory against the printed yield 88.7％. CLOSES to within 0.02 of a percentage point. This establishes the convention for the whole section: yields are computed on purity-corrected mass. Uncorrected the printed mass is 89.75％ of theory, still within 1.1 points, so the step closes on either reading. No mass_balance_implausible. First step of the section, so no continuity check. VALIDATION_FLAGS EMPTY. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.

quote_zh: 2、2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸的合成 ... 将34.2g  2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(99.8％、0.1mol)，27.88g碳酸钾(99％、0.2mol)，2.26g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.01mol)，200ml  DMF，1.13g2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.2mol)加入500ml反应瓶中，在20～25℃进行反应，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完毕后过滤，滤液浓缩。往剩余物里8.1g氢氧化钠(99％、0.2mol)，200ml水，在70～75℃进行碱解，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后滴加盐酸酸化，过滤，洗涤，烘干得31.1g白色粉末，纯度99.5％，收率89.3％。
arithmetic_check: Charges, each checked with the printed percentage applied. Substrate methyl 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate C10H10BrClO4S, MW 341.60: 34.2 g x 99.8％ = 34.132 g / 0.1 mol implies 341.3, correct. Potassium carbonate K2CO3, MW 138.20: 27.88 g x 99％ = 27.601 g gives 0.1997 mol against 0.2 mol, correct. Sodium hydroxide NaOH, MW 40.00: 8.1 g x 99％ = 8.019 g gives 0.2005 mol against 0.2 mol, correct. TWO PAIRS DO NOT CLOSE, AND THEY ARE THE ONLY TWO IN THE SECTION THAT DO NOT. (a) 1.13g2,2,2-三氟乙醇(99％、0.2mol): 2,2,2-trifluoroethanol is C2H3F3O, MW 100.04; the printed pair implies a molecular weight of 1.13 / 0.2 = 5.65, or 5.59 with the assay applied, against 100.04; read the other way, 1.13 g x 99％ = 1.119 g is 0.0112 mol and not 0.2 mol; the mass that would carry 0.2 mol at 99％ is 20.21 g, so the printed mass is short by a factor of 17.9. (b) 2.26g三乙烯二胺(99％、0.01mol): triethylenediamine is C6H12N2, MW 112.18; the printed pair implies 226.0, or 223.7 with the assay applied, against 112.18, that is a factor of 2.0; read the other way, 2.26 g x 99％ = 2.237 g is 0.01995 mol, almost exactly twice the printed 0.01 mol. The mass that would make the printed 0.01 mol correct is 1.133 g, which rounds to 1.13 g, exactly the mass printed against the trifluoroethanol; the mass actually printed against the triethylenediamine is twice that. Recorded as an observation about the printed line, not acted on and not repaired. Flag: molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure gives opposite answers on the two readings, which is itself the finding. On the printed MOLE counts it closes: the bromide is limiting at 0.100 mol; product 2-chloro-3-(2,2,2-trifluoroethoxy)methyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoic acid C11H10ClF3O5S, MW 346.70; theoretical 34.67 g; printed 31.1 g at the printed purity 99.5％ is 30.945 g, which is 89.25％ of theory against the printed yield 89.3％. On the printed MASSES it cannot close: the printed 1.13 g of trifluoroethanol at 99％ is 0.0112 mol and can supply at most 0.0112 mol of the ether, that is 3.88 g of product, against the 31.1 g printed, so the stated product mass exceeds what the stated trifluoroethanol charge could give by roughly eightfold. Flag: mass_balance_implausible, raised on the mass reading and not on the mole reading, both readings stated so the flag can be checked. Continuity: step 1 isolated 30.66 g of the bromide and this step charges 34.2 g of it, 3.54 g more than the preceding step produced. Flag: scale_discontinuity. Numbers recorded exactly as printed and no plausible mass substituted for either defective pair.

quote_zh: 3、环磺酮的合成 ... 将34.72g  2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸(99.8％、0.1mol)，0.74g  DMF(99％、0.01mol)，24g氯化亚砜(99％、0.2mol)，100ml二氯乙烷加入250ml反应瓶中，升温回流反应，反应完毕后脱尽溶剂。将22.6g  1,3-环己二酮(99％、0.2mol)、100ml二氯甲烷加入反应瓶，在5～10℃滴加30.6g三乙胺(99％、0.3mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全。反应完全后，加入0.89g丙酮氰醇(95％、0.01mol)，LC跟踪至反应完全，反应完全后加入水进行水洗，分层，油层脱尽溶剂，加乙醇进行重结晶，过滤，烘干得38.1g米黄色结晶粉末，纯度98.7％，收率85.4％。
arithmetic_check: Charges, each checked with the printed percentage applied. N,N-dimethylformamide C3H7NO, MW 73.09: 0.74 g x 99％ = 0.733 g gives 0.01002 mol against 0.01 mol, correct. Thionyl chloride SOCl2, MW 118.97: 24 g x 99％ = 23.76 g gives 0.1997 mol against 0.2 mol, correct. Cyclohexane-1,3-dione C6H8O2, MW 112.13: 22.6 g x 99％ = 22.374 g gives 0.1995 mol against 0.2 mol, correct. Triethylamine C6H15N, MW 101.19: 30.6 g x 99％ = 30.294 g gives 0.2994 mol against 0.3 mol, correct. Acetone cyanohydrin C4H7NO, MW 85.11: 0.89 g x 95％ = 0.846 g gives 0.00993 mol against 0.01 mol, correct. No molar_mass_inconsistent. Product closure: limiting input 0.100 mol of the benzoic acid; product tembotrione C17H16ClF3O6S as named and drawn, MW 440.82; theoretical 0.100 x 440.82 = 44.08 g; printed 38.1 g at the printed purity 98.7％ is 37.605 g of pure product, which is 85.31％ of theory against the printed yield 85.4％. CLOSES to within 0.1 of a percentage point. No mass_balance_implausible. Continuity: step 2 isolated 31.1 g of the benzoic acid and this step charges 34.72 g of it, 3.62 g more than the preceding step produced, the same pattern as at the step 1 to step 2 boundary; each step of the section restarts at a clean 0.1 mol. Flag: scale_discontinuity, the only flag on this step. Numbers recorded exactly as printed.
